FAQsFrequently asked questions

What accounting work does Totum AI automate?

Totum AI is an AI accountant for bill processing, entries, invoicing, bank reconciliation, and reports across multiple companies. Automated integrations with Gmail, WhatsApp, and Slack bring accounting documents and requests into your workflows. Start tasks through chat or voice and review exceptions using your connected ERP.

Can I manage accounting for multiple companies?

Yes. Totum AI supports multiple companies in one workspace, so you can work on entries, invoices, reconciliation, and reports for each company.

Can I use my ERP on my phone with Totum AI?

Yes. Totum AI lets you work with data from Tally, Zoho, or Busy on your phone, desktop, and chat, so you do not need to open your ERP for every task.

Does Totum AI work with my existing ERP setup?

Yes. Totum AI works alongside your existing Tally, Zoho, or Busy workflow, helping you create entries, upload bills, track payments, and access reports faster.

Can Totum AI upload bills to my ERP automatically?

Yes. You can upload bills, photos, and files, and Totum AI helps turn them into ERP-ready entries so your bookkeeping team spends less time on manual data entry.

Can business owners view dashboards and reports without opening their ERP?

Yes. Totum AI gives business owners instant access to dashboards, business summaries, and key reports without needing to operate their ERP directly.

Does Totum AI automate workflows with Gmail, WhatsApp, and Slack?

Yes. Totum AI integrates with Gmail, WhatsApp, and Slack to bring documents and accounting requests into automated workflows. Teams can ask questions, request reports, and start accounting tasks through connected conversations.

Is Totum AI meant for accountants, business owners, or both?

Both. Accountants can use Totum AI to speed up entries and reporting, while business owners can use it to monitor operations, payments, and decisions without depending on manual follow-ups.

More from Totum AI

Short guides and real stories for owners and accountants.
